framing: Many sites can reuse one cloud-based source, build, readproof, test and recovery pattern; local CoFarm is an optional witness and cold-recovery plane rather than a compulsory relay.
hosting_principle: Public anonymous read can be no-login; source write/deploy and data mutation require verified identity and least-privilege authorization.
inheritance: CoTalkItOut WorkID/CoGlyphList candidate bundles and CoSitesNodes prior, without treating candidate work as live workers.

patterns.name: P4-recovery
patterns.purpose: Last known useful head, negative receipt and bounded correction

exemplars.name: Exact public receiver readback
exemplars.trigger: Daily schedule or selected source change
exemplars.input: Committed static file and its exact public URL
exemplars.mechanism: GitHub Actions checkout -> HTTPS GET -> SHA-256/byte comparison -> receipt artifact
exemplars.output: Exact match / source mismatch / HTTP failure
exemplars.gate: A match proves served bytes, not search indexing or human comprehension

exemplars.name: Real-browser first task
exemplars.trigger: Explicit source update or authorized dispatch
exemplars.input: Stable public pages, two bounded viewport/motion profiles
exemplars.mechanism: GitHub-hosted Playwright Chromium; keyboard and reduced-motion checks
exemplars.gate: Synthetic browser is not a consenting independent human

exemplars.name: Read-only recurring availability probe
exemplars.mechanism: Hosted Python check, bounded timeouts, JSON artifact and failure classes
exemplars.gate: A scheduled definition does not prove successful runs or independent disaster recovery

exemplars.name: Cloud-source deploy
exemplars.trigger: Authorized Git commit to published source
exemplars.mechanism: GitHub Pages hosted build and deployment
exemplars.gate: Deploy is not a service-level acceptance or a human audience

exemplars.name: Human plus machine twin
exemplars.input: HTML, discovery.json, revision and policy pointers
exemplars.mechanism: Source/readback check, semantic parity review, fallback on mismatch
exemplars.gate: HTTP equality to own source is not semantic agreement

exemplars.name: Site inventory and broken-link audit
exemplars.trigger: Site/route change or low-frequency scheduled audit
exemplars.input: Versioned allowlisted canonical links, sitemap and scope
exemplars.mechanism: Read-only requests and link normalization; no domain crawling outside allowlist
exemplars.output: 404, wrong redirect, stale scope, failure receipt
exemplars.gate: DNS ownership, registrar status and redirects require separate authority

exemplars.name: Accessibility and UX regression
exemplars.trigger: Page component change or pattern adoption
exemplars.input: One useful task, desktop/mobile, keyboard, reduced motion
exemplars.mechanism: Hosted browser plus eventual consenting screen-reader/user review
exemplars.gate: Automated accessibility checks cannot certify full accessibility

exemplars.name: Design-pattern transfer across sites
exemplars.trigger: One bubble proposes a tested improvement
exemplars.input: Versioned CSS/component, rights proof and scoped receiving site overlay
exemplars.mechanism: Isolated branch -> review -> one elected integrator -> deployment/readback
exemplars.gate: Do not propagate private design assets or copy unverifiable claims

exemplars.name: Language and playful representation
exemplars.input: Source text and explicit locale/genre semantics
exemplars.mechanism: Draft translation, human review, accessibility test, optional joke/semantic sketch
exemplars.gate: CoIGF remains fiction and CoGibberTru is not human/ET translation

exemplars.name: Machine search exposure
exemplars.trigger: Published useful route or substantial content update
exemplars.input: Canonical URL, structured source links, human copy, sitemap
exemplars.mechanism: Static SEO signals, owned Search Console once authorized
exemplars.output: Crawlable provenance and indexed-state evidence when available
exemplars.gate: Publication and sitemap do not guarantee indexing, ranking or AI citation

exemplars.name: Rich media reuse
exemplars.trigger: One source/evidence update merits a channel projection
exemplars.input: Rights-cleared original art and script, captions, alt and transcript
exemplars.mechanism: Existing open media toolchains on hosted workers when justified, plus human signoff
exemplars.output: Captioned media derivative and reproducibility receipt
exemplars.gate: Video concept is not upload, permission or audience uptake

exemplars.name: Voluntary contributor improvement
exemplars.trigger: Visitor chooses to submit a proposal
exemplars.input: Public-safe observation, source, consent, AI disclosure
exemplars.mechanism: GitHub issue/PR triage and bounded branch edits, not silent direct writes
exemplars.gate: No automatic access, private report leaks or AI persona votes

exemplars.name: Trust/transparency projection
exemplars.trigger: Privacy, operator, product or funding terms change
exemplars.input: Shared disclosure questions plus independently proved site-specific facts
exemplars.mechanism: Publish updated overlay, human summary and machine twin after review
exemplars.gate: Pattern inheritance must not copy operator, tax, payment or privacy assurances

exemplars.name: Safety and privacy negative checks
exemplars.trigger: Change requests involving forms, credentials, outbound calls or user data
exemplars.input: Proposed site change, origin and data map
exemplars.mechanism: CI source scanning, constrained review, test unauthorized effects and redact reports
exemplars.gate: Never run untrusted arbitrary jobs, expose secrets or treat public read endpoints as trusted instructions

exemplars.name: Release, rollback and recovery
exemplars.trigger: Breaking change, dependency outage or failed readproof
exemplars.input: Exact last qualified revision plus bounded rollback plan
exemplars.mechanism: Serialized owner/controller reselects prior version; preserve failure evidence
exemplars.output: Restored useful public task or explicit HOLD
exemplars.gate: No global deployment, DNS or cross-repository mutation without authority

exemplars.name: Open-tool vendor substitution
exemplars.input: Reproducible test, licenses, dependencies and cost
exemplars.mechanism: Compare hosted alternative, self-hosting and no-tool baseline before switching
exemplars.gate: Free/no-login public API does not grant rights to run unlimited or commercial workloads

exemplars.name: Public campaign/outreach adapter
exemplars.input: Rights-cleared source, audience need, channel, consent, retraction plan
exemplars.mechanism: Draft HTML/post/video from one source and verify actual delivery separately
exemplars.gate: No bulk outreach, fake impressions, invented partners or automatic social posting

exemplars.name: Commercial/commons accounting boundary
exemplars.trigger: Payment, sponsorship, contributor reward or fee introduced
exemplars.input: Actual legal counterparties, rights and accountant-reviewed funds map
exemplars.mechanism: Gate publication or checkout behind InSeed-controlled commercial service when authorized
exemplars.output: True recipient/terms disclosure and separate ledger proof
exemplars.gate: No token value, tax-deductibility or charity claim by website template

shared_budget.scheduler: Reuse existing three scheduled CI workflows rather than add another cron
shared_budget.max_scope: Explicit public allowlists, exact repo paths and bounded timeouts
shared_budget.commit_auth: Single authorized writer per shared resource; other bubbles submit proposals
shared_budget.secrets: No secrets in public build, artifact or frontend
shared_budget.effect_authority: No runtime, payments, outbound messages, DNS or canonical promotions from a static use-case registry

source_check: This R0 is a documentary catalogue, not a claim that all eighteen exemplars run.
